an4.1:1.2: On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling among the Vajjis at Bhaṇḍagāma.
an4.1:1.3: There the Blessed One addressed the bhikkhus:
an4.1:2.1: “Bhikkhus, it is because of not understanding and penetrating four things that you and I have roamed and wandered for such a long stretch of time.
an4.1:2.3: “It is, bhikkhus, because of not understanding and penetrating noble virtuous behavior,
an4.1:2.6: and noble liberation that you and I have roamed and wandered for such a long stretch of time.
an4.1:2.7: “Noble virtuous behavior has been understood and penetrated. Noble concentration has been understood and penetrated. Noble wisdom has been understood and penetrated. Noble liberation has been understood and penetrated. Craving for existence has been cut off; the conduit to existence has been destroyed; now there is no more renewed existence.”
an4.1:3.1: This is what the Blessed One said.
an4.1:3.2: Having said this, the Fortunate One, the Teacher, further said this:
an4.1:5.2: the Buddha taught the Dhamma to the bhikkhus.
an4.1:5.3: The Teacher, the end-maker of suffering,
an4.1:5.4: the One with Vision, has attained nibbāna.”
